summary: Sexual assault on minor in 1986; trial court conviction under IPC s.376 based on eyewitness and medical evidence; High Court acquittal overturned for failure to independently evaluate evidence; delay in FIR justified due to remoteness and severity of injuries; victim's identity protected; prosecution case upheld with corroboration from PW-2 and medical findings; benefit of reasonable doubt misapplied by High Court; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court acquittal set aside; conviction and 7-year rigorous imprisonment under s.376 IPC restored.
